scope: Fresh complete narration-script reading and actual viewing of every scene overview, every provided motion overview and at least one native encoded frame per reviewed lesson. Findings cite selected scenes and native timestamps; no continuous playback, full audible listening, majority-frame or every-frame review is claimed. Visual and animation scores are independent fresh editorial judgments out of100. Every provided all-scenes motion atlas was also actually viewed: three encoded samples from the most active narrated beat of every authored scene, selected using decoded-frame metrics. These strengthen scene coverage while remaining samples. Findings and scores were reassessed against the broader evidence. The reviewed MP4 identities remain the baseline renders; source repairs require new encoded review.

findings.fix: In videos/animations/cuda-execution.mjs, warps beats 1–2, keep lane identities visible while regrouping, enlarge a selected 0/31/32 boundary, and mute inactive numbers. Preserve the useful clock-endpoint animation.

findings.issue: The selected beat3 motion samples shrink h from roughly0.001 to0.00006, but the secant and tangent already coincide at the display scale, so most visible change is decimal text.
findings.fix: In videos/animations/gradients-backprop.mjs, derivative-limit beat3, add a magnified local inset or angle/difference indicator synchronized with h. Keep the successful connected forward/reverse graph and native LaTeX.

findings.fix: In videos/animations/convolution.mjs, patch beat 1, highlight the current pixel/weight pair in a shared color and connect it to the corresponding product. Preserve the existing visible-product subtotal and fixed kernel during sliding.

findings.issue: At289.27s a clean terminal-write-failure state is shown, but comparing it with the earlier initial-write failure requires remembering counts and trace status after the scene switches.

Move one named request through each path and update0/1 invocation and absent/running trace exactly at the failing boundary.

findings.issue: At297.1s the green ask59 explanation sits beside the horizontal blue review54 line, while the review54 explanation is far below. The decisive4.4% crossing has no marker; the endpoint at25% receives the only dot. This makes the visual decision boundary harder to read than the script.
findings.fix: In videos/animations/reinforcement-learning.mjs, uncertain-transition beats1–2, directly label the horizontal review curve at54 and sloping evidence curve in matching colors, add a vertical4.4% crossing line, and move a visible probability control across it with a clear chosen-action switch.

findings.issue: Many invented reward numbers and repeated formulas compete with the state transition story. The sampled graphs emphasize final return values more than the immediate reward→next state→discounted consequence mechanism.
findings.fix: Carry one REQ identity through a short trajectory, collect reward chips on transitions, then collapse that same trajectory into the Bellman backup. Reveal only the currently needed numerical term and shorten repeated theorem conditions in narration.

findings.issue: At222.03s the dots read as hard group assignments, the colored/yellow vertical bars lack old/new-mean labels, and floating formulas carry the fractional-membership mechanism. The E-step responsibilities are not visibly connected to this centroid update.
findings.fix: In videos/animations/expectation-maximization.mjs, m-step beat1, retain each observation identity and split its contribution by responsibility. Animate weighted numerator and effective count into a labeled new mean; show old mean dashed and new mean solid. Then update variance using the same weighted points.

findings.issue: At130.33s the frame says backward and displays stored gradients, but only clear-gradients→forward is cyan. Loss→backward remains gray, so visual flow contradicts current execution state. Source defines activeEdge but never uses it; edges use beat>i.
findings.fix: In videos/animations/training-loop.mjs:262–272, derive completed/current edges from modelSnapshot.stage, use the intended activeEdge mapping, and pulse only the handoff that actually writes the shown state. Add a state-to-highlight invariant covering forward,backward,optimizer phases.

findings.issue: At196.6s grades are shown above three final DCG/IDCG/NDCG boxes. The ranking animation elsewhere is strong, but the discount-weighted contribution of each position is hidden behind the final numbers.
findings.fix: In videos/animations/recommendation.mjs, ranking-metrics beats1–2, carry each same-document grade into its gain and position discount, accumulate five contributions, then divide by an ideal-order total. Retain stable document movement in reranking/slate-policy.

findings.issue: The all-scenes atlas confirms that search reveals two authored candidate programs, their different instructions/demonstrations, final development counts, and candidate selection. It does not show a development failure producing the instruction or demonstration edit, so the central optimization feedback loop remains implicit.
findings.fix: In videos/animations/prompt-optimization.mjs, search beats1–2, execute a small deterministic case fixture, show the baseline failing action+target matching, edit the exact instruction/demo, rerun that same case, and carry the score into candidate selection. Use a locked held-out case card that opens only after the selected artifact is frozen.

findings.issue: At275.13s the idempotent retry is two generic cards joined by an arrow. The key and pending count are readable, but the same queued object is never made the visual identity shared by initial insert,lost reply,retry and replay.
findings.fix: In videos/animations/design-conversational-ai-support-bot.mjs, ledger beats1–2, keep one labeled queue entry with operation key/invoice/$35 identity on screen; animate the first insertion,drop only its reply,then route the retry to that existing entry without adding a second. Reuse a labeled queue-entry catalog object.
